title: Pivotality in bribed tribes
statement: Let $w,s\in\mathbb N$, let $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,sw\}$ be a set of coordinates, and let $i$ be a coordinate outside $J$. For an input $x\in\{\pm1\}^{sw}$, if the tribes function remains pivotal at $i$ after every coordinate in $J$ is set to $+1$, then every other coordinate in the same block as $i$ has value $-1$ in $x$.
hypotheses_covered: Coordinate i belongs to the full cube of dimension sw
Input x is a sign vector of length sw
Pivotality of the bribed tribes function at i, with bribed value +1
